question: Can a platform-identical source of genuinely unseen continuous actions and hidden within-episode causal-map changes be prequalified against a competent calibrated conventional 256-float memory baseline before any original Hybrid training or science first use?

generator.algorithm: Use only Python hashlib.sha256(namespace='p86-portable-v1', split_seed, world_index, field_tag, index...) and little-endian unsigned int from digest first 4 bytes modulo the frozen discrete range to generate *integer* tensors; DO NOT use torch/NumPy random, torch QR or platform transcendental functions to generate source. For each world independent 16x4 action and effect causal low-rank bases with integer entries uniformly in {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}. Each of 49 16D executed actions or query has deterministic independent integer components uniformly in [-96,96]; convert action float32 = a_int / 128 exactly, effect float32 = sum_k(sum_j(a_int[j]*action_basis[j,k])*effect_basis[d,k])/16384 exactly (integer arithmetic then power-of-two division). No noise. 48 actually executed historical actions, regime switch after 24 in exactly half worlds to independent second integer low-rank causal map, final query is action49 and true effect under final causal map. Source is deterministic on Windows/Linux and float values are exactly representable with no QR/cosine float arithmetic in source itself.
generator.source_shape: history[N,48,32] = actually executed 16D action plus its actually observed 16D outcome, query[N,32] = new 16D action + 16 zero withheld-effect features, target[N,16] = effect of final query; internal evaluator_only changed_world[N] bool never passed to prediction/update.

generator.audits: Source SHA256 over bytes of history/query/target/evaluator regime; FIT and CAL SHA must match the initial local receipt byte-for-byte in both G4 CPU platforms. All tensors finite, exact dyadic values, no query-history cosine>=.999, exactly half regimes, no future effect or role/clock/source label supplied to write. Recompute deterministic source twice. On mismatch mark FAIL and DO NOT weaken test or interpret outcomes as reproducible.
generator.source_boundary: Never generate RESERVED_HELDOUT or RESERVED_NEGATIVE at this preflight. No P65-P85 reused data. Not independently witnessed real-world external intervention; P84-MR owns CausalGym first-use.

gates.pre_source: Source FIT/CAL strict exact SHA and query novelty audits PASS, 256 float32 prediction state exactly, original source Git blobs match, P78 ETA=.5 comparator bitwise-approx <=1e-7.

gates.stop: On platform source SHA discrepancy, STOP qualification; do not silently regenerate a 'compatible' source on the same frozen cohort. Need a new prospective protocol if source implementation changes.
